programmes.d: It was at the end of February 2005 that Françoise Chabé was found dead at her home. It was her partner who found her lifeless body. He quickly became the police's prime suspect.
In 1992, Sylviane Kaas was found dead in her bedroom. Her husband had been the prime suspect for several years. Now exonerated, this murder remains unpunished.
July 2000, Vaucluse, a few kilometers from Avignon. Richard Alessandri, 42, a wealthy supermarket owner, is shot dead in his sleep. Everything suggests that it was a home-jacking gone wrong.

A veterinarian rushes home because his wife, with whom he had an appointment for lunch in a local brasserie, is no longer answering her phone. He discovers his wife's body lying in her blood in the bathtub.

It was exactly 32 years ago! The Anaïs Marcelli case, named after this 10-year-old girl abducted on January 14, 1991 as she left school in Mulhouse, has just been taken over by the Nanterre cold case unit.
When Nathalie Tronche, Lucas' mother, returned from work, her son had disappeared and the teenager was not answering his phone. The Montpellier police were called in to investigate.
In Guilvinec in Finistère, the body of Marie-Michèle Calvez was discovered in the trunk of her burned car. This murder is a real criminal enigma. Who killed this 40-year-old woman loved by all?
In Fos-sur-Mer in the Bouches-du-Rhône, Nadine Chabert said goodbye for the last time to her daughter Émilie. No one would see this 33-year-old mother again.
The body of Ghislaine Leclerc was discovered in her house in Volesvres in Saône et Loire. In an attempt to solve the murder of this 57-year-old woman, the police follow many leads.
The firefighters of Annemasse in Haute-Savoie were alerted by an anonymous call of the presence of an injured man lying on a small road at the exit of the city.
In Saint-Malo, the body of a teenage girl was found below a cliff.
A man who had molested his daughter for a number of years is shot and killed by his daughter. Next, a murder witness is tortured and murdered by a gang member.
In this episode, we look at the stories of two women who were convicted of murdering their mothers.
This episode features a woman who was convicted of murdering her ex-boyfriend after years of alleged abuse and a woman who killed her grandmother.
This episode features stories of one woman who was convicted of the death of her adopted daughter and a handicapped man who was pushed into a river by his wife.
A woman explains why she hired a hitman to kill her fourth husband. Next, an addict watched as a fellow gang member robbed and murdered an unsuspecting man.
